# why (explanation-seeking)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:typeWhy`](gmeow-typeWhy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/typeWhy>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inquiry`](../../slices/inquiry.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An explanation-seeking question — its answerhood condition is a set of explanations of a fact (the explanandum). Bridges the abduction tetrad: a [`typeWhy`](gmeow-typeWhy.md) question's explanandum is exactly the abductive explanandum, so abduction answers [`typeWhy`](gmeow-typeWhy.md) questions; the bridge is documented routing, not an axiom.
